verdict.rationale: HubSpot ships several natural-language interaction surfaces — Breeze Assistant lets users 'describe the report you need in plain language' and 'plan a full campaign from a single goal, in one session,' and the official MCP server lets any MCP-compatible AI agent read/write CRM data, effectively enabling NL-driven operation through connected AI tools. However these are discrete features (reporting, campaign planning, prospecting agent) rather than a unified NL command layer covering the whole product, and there's no independent/hands-on evidence validating reliability of these NL features. Missing for 10: evidence of a general-purpose NL command interface spanning all core workflows, and independent corroboration of the NL features actually working as described.
